explanation: In math, fires on a numeric (or letter) coefficient written right after '=' or an opening '$' that multiplies what follows by juxtaposition: '= [5](-7/11)', '= [4](4j)', '= [6]E', '= [3]a', '[2]x = 3y', '[a](a)', '[f](f(x))'. Two strong web-text excerpts on the modal 'can' are unrelated to this.
